reviews_verbatim.author: James Szczepanski
reviews_verbatim.text: Igor, is a true gentleman and professional his attention to detail installing my baseboard in my home in the evergreen community was outstanding price was great also. I will be using Igor on my next project. Look no further if you need a handyman man. Thanks Igor.

reviews_verbatim.author: June Downs
reviews_verbatim.text: We couldn't be happier with the deck Igor rebuilt for us. He is honest, hard working and efficient. You can't ask for more quality work.

reviews_verbatim.author: Jamie Balkin
reviews_verbatim.text: Igor is an excellent craftsmen. I am a very busy person and I have limited time to get repairs done. It was very important to gain trust in a handy man. Upon meeting him I new I could call on him and new this was the person I was looking …

reviews_verbatim.author: Linda Niosi
reviews_verbatim.text: Igor was very professional. He fixed my fence and deck. He was on time and his work was impeccable. He completed the job and left my property clean. Will definitely use him on other projects around the home.

reviews_verbatim.author: Karen Stowell
reviews_verbatim.text: Igor was a joy to work with! Honest, kind and fair. The painting he did in my home came out beautifully! A lot of attention to detail. I plan on using him again to rebuild my deck. I definitely recommend his services!! …

review_summary_snippets_google: Igor and his staff renovated my guest bathroom.
He always does an excellent job, always looking out for the customer first.....
Very reliable, personable, accomidating and does fine work.
